earnings.title: Intel Corporation
highlights: Third-quarter revenue was $16.5 billion, up 21% year-over-year (YoY).
Third-quarter earnings per share (EPS) attributable to Intel was $0.60; non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel was $0.52.
Forecasting fourth-quarter 2026 revenue of $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion; forecasting fourth-quarter EPS attributable to Intel of $0.10 and non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel of $0.25.
Gross margin 43.0% 38.2% up 4.8 ppts 44.1% 40.0% up 4.1 ppts

quotes.text: Our Q3 results demonstrate improving execution, meaningful progress expanding supply and continued advancement of our process technology.
